representation_plans.learner_operation: Classify the alcohol carbon, identify hydrogen-bonding capacity, and select oxidation or substitution behavior.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text table names alcohol class, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, carbon substitution, oxidizable hydrogen availability, and substitution conditions.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Distinguish temporary masking from leaving-group activation and track which bond changes during activation and later substitution.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text reaction sequence names the protected alcohol, deprotection step, sulfonate ester, and any later carbon substitution separately.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Locate the carboxyl carbon and adjacent 2-position, then classify derivative formation, reduction, decarboxylation, or alpha substitution.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text map lists starting functional group, carbon retained or lost, nucleophile introduced, and product class.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Track the incoming nucleophile, tetrahedral intermediate, departing group, and restored carbonyl.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A numbered text mechanism states bond formation, carbonyl pi-bond opening, intermediate collapse, and leaving-group departure.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Compare leaving-group stability, resonance donation, steric access, electronic effects, and ring strain before ranking reactivity.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text comparison lists each derivative’s departing group, resonance donation, steric environment, and strain.
